chunks: Have they not contemplated the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything created by God, (to educe) that perhaps their own term is drawing to a close? In what lore after this would they then believe?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about contemplating creation as a sign for belief?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the intellectual path to faith, urging believers to contemplate the 'malakut' (realm of divine sovereignty) within the cosmos as a rational proof of the Creator. It underscores the urgency of divine judgment, suggesting that if natural signs fail to move the disbelievers, no further textual revelation will suffice. This reflects the Shia emphasis on 'aql' (reason) working in tandem with revelation to establish certainty.
